blocks.text: The Melissa & Doug Examine and Treat Pet Vet Play Set gives kids the tools to role play as veterinarians. This 24-piece set includes a plush dog and cat, stethoscope, thermometer, syringe, ear scope, tweezers, bottles, and more. A reusable checklist lets kids track office visits and treatments, while a durable tote keeps everything organized for house calls or storage. Children can examine their plush patients, give pretend shots, and complete checkups, creating opportunities for role play that supports communication and problem-solving. This set also helps kids understand pet care and develop empathy through hands-on activities. Designed for ages 3 and up, it encourages screen-free play and social interaction. It pairs well with other Melissa & Doug role play sets for extended pretend scenarios at home or in group settings For more exciting pretend play, combine this set with the Melissa and Doug Get Well Doctor Kit, & Beauty Salon Playset, to build the ultimate pretend play world for hours of hands-on, screen-free play For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!
